title: Asterisk CDR Codec and Post-Dial Delay Anomalies
exclusions: Exclude planned maintenance windows, DR exercises, vendor pack updates, and seasonal demand patterns via asset/schedule lookup.
evidence: Saved search `21_8_15_evidence` archived to restricted audit index.

controlTest.positiveScenario: Replay sample `scada:alarm` events into `index=voip`. Confirm UC-21.8.15 search returns >=1 row.
controlTest.negativeScenario: Replay benign `scada:alarm` traffic without alert markers. Confirm the search returns zero rows.

app: Asterisk CDR to CSV via `cdr-csv` + Universal Forwarder, or ODBC CDR mirror to DB + DB Connect
spl:
index=voip sourcetype="scada:alarm" sourcetype=asterisk:cdr
| stats count as event_count dc(host) as distinct_assets by substation_id
| where event_count > 0
| table _time substation_id alarm_id priority shelved
description: Post-dial delay (PDD) approximated as `duration - billsec` on answered calls highlights SIP routing or transcoding stalls. A rising median PDD or exploding mix of codecs per hour often precedes MOS complaints even when trunks show green.
value: Operations and risk leaders in Telecommunications use signals from Asterisk CDR Codec and Post-Dial Delay Anomalies to move crews, budget, and customer or regulator communications while the situation is still controllable, so the organization steers from live telemetry rather than a post-incident report.
implementation: Ensure `asterisk:cdr` field extraction matches your `Master.csv` column order—common positions documented in Asterisk samples. If using custom CDR fields for negotiated codec, map to `dstcodec`. Tune PDD threshold: mobile interconnection may legitimately be higher. Investigate codec_mix>3 as transcoding or misconfigured peering.
visualization: Line chart (med_pdd), Pie chart (codec share), Table (trunk groups).
knownFalsePositives: CDR delay or codec oddities after gateway failovers, transcoder drain, or PSTN trunk work that the voice engineering bridge documented on the NOC call.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Consistent CSV headers in `cdr.conf`.
• Exclude conference bridges if they skew PDD.

Step 1 — Validate PDD vs PCAP on a test call.

Step 2 — Join with SIP `INVITE` logs if available.

Step 3 — Document carrier-specific baselines.

Step 4 — Feed ITSI KPI if using premium.
grandmaExplanation: We watch CDR quality and post-dial delay. We help you catch switch or routing oddities before billing disputes start.
telcoUseCase: Troubleshooting one-way audio and post-dial delay — track `billsec`, `amaflags`, and negotiated codec fields in Master.csv-style CDR.
